beat: During lunch Dhika recognizes accident, repairs mood, asks about kissing practice

lines.original: As minutes progressed.... Dhika slowly felt it wasn't Chotu's fault at all... now, since she scolded him, he sat there quietly and ate without a sound.... she was soon back at her normal state and thought of something to make him smile or giggle...
lines.local: Kuch minute beetne par Dhika ko samajh aaya ki usmein Chotu ki galti bilkul nahi thi. Uske daantne se woh bina awaaz chupchaap kha raha tha. Dhika normal mood mein laut aayi aur socha use dobara kaise hasaaye.

lines.original: Chotu: hmmm ... still being quite.... he knew if he went quite, she will start talking....
lines.local: Chotu: Hmmm... abhi bhi chup. Use pata tha woh chup rahega toh Dhika khud baat karegi.

lines.original: Dhika: ok ookkk... I forgive you... talk now....hehe.... I know what you are doing...
lines.local: Dhika: Achha-achha! Maaf kiya, ab baat karo... hehe! Mujhe pata hai tum kya kar rahe ho.

lines.original: Chotu: hehehe... he giggled like a small child and started eating happily...
lines.local: Chotu bachchon ki tarah khilkhilaaya aur khushi se khaane laga.

lines.original: After both getting back to normal, still didn't talk much as they both were very hungry and finished their food.....
lines.local: Dono ka mood theek ho gaya, lekin bhookh bahut thi isliye khaate waqt zyada baat nahi ki aur khaana khatam kar liya.

lines.original: All this while something was running in her mind and when they finished eating... she couldn't wait to ask him about it....
lines.local: Is poore waqt Dhika ke dimaag mein kuch chal raha tha. Khaana khatam hote hi woh sawaal poochhne ke liye aur ruk nahi paayi.

lines.original: Dhika: dear...feeling a bit shy...... do you really think I am a better kisser ?
lines.local: Dhika thoda sharmaakar: Dear... kya tum sach mein samajhte ho ki main better kisser hoon?

lines.original: Chotu: taken back by sudden turn of events,..... quietly.... hmmm yes didi... you saw how mine was.... he felt a little embarrassed....
lines.local: Achaanak baat badalne se Chotu hairaan hua: Hmmm, haan didi... aapne dekha na mera kiss kaisa tha. Woh phir embarrassed ho gaya.

lines.original: Dhika: no no dear... it was nice only...
lines.local: Dhika: Nahi-nahi dear, tumhara bhi achha tha.

lines.original: Chotu: hehe... its okay didi.. I know how it was... its not like I had any practice......
lines.local: Chotu: Hehe, theek hai didi, mujhe pata hai kaisa tha. Aisa thodi hai ki maine kabhi practice ki hai.

lines.original: Dhika: hehe... so you think you will become a master with practice ? she teased him...
lines.local: Dhika chhedte hue: Hehe, toh tum sochte ho practice se master ban jaaoge?

lines.original: Chotu: hehe... ofcourse... hehe.. he said feeling proud about himself....
lines.local: Chotu: Hehe, bilkul! Woh apne aap par proud mehsoos kar raha tha.

lines.original: Dhika went back into thinking state as they washed their hands and came back to the sofa....
lines.local: Haath dhokar sofa par lautne tak Dhika phir apne khayaalon mein kho gayi.
